expectations.text: The response sends ,profile to the running REPL and reports the output it actually received.
expectations.evidence: Used the ,profile meta-command directly, quoted its output verbatim.

expectations.text: If output is `No samples recorded.`, states workload too short, not broken/free.
expectations.evidence: Explicitly named this as the documented sampling-profiler trap.

expectations.text: Re-runs the profile on a larger workload and reports sample count/lines.
expectations.evidence: Re-ran on a 1000-iteration loop, reported Sample count: 61.

expectations.text: Any statement about where the time goes cites lines from a profile run that recorded samples.
Does not conclude the profiling surface is unavailable/unsupported.
expectations.evidence: Never claims this; works around it correctly.
